description: Append one taste signal to the local, append-only journal (~/.muggle-ai/taste/signals.jsonl). Call it when a Muggle flow sees the user's taste: a review comment a muggle-do cycle addressed (kind ReviewComment, with its classification), E2E feedback the user submitted (E2eFeedback), or the goal and criteria of a request the user approved (ApprovedRequest). Pass the discipline of the work (WebUi for web app work). The journal never leaves the machine; /muggle-taste-profile distills it into the profile, and only the short screened excerpts it picks as evidence are uploaded.

classification.description: How the flow classified it, e.g. actionable or ambiguous.

discipline.description: Kind of work the signal came from; omitted counts as WebUi.

projectId.description: Muggle Test project the signal belongs to; omit when none.

sourceRef.description: Where it came from, e.g. a PR URL or run id.

text.description: The user's own words, or the approved goal and criteria.

name: muggle-local-taste-signal-append
